newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash slides on outright price crash, LLS weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash slides on outright price crash, LLS weak.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes slid sharply lower by the close on Monday, deflated by a deep technical sell-off in the NYMEX futures market.
At the same time, large parcels of Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James barrels were sold throughout the session at a 10 cts premium to the West Texas Intermediate/Cushing.
LLS numbers further cemented the near-term trend for softer grade differentials in the face of stiff foreign bids.
"Big volumes of LLS were done at 10 cts (over WTI). It's the real cheap foreign crudes pushing it," said a trader.
Feb WTI ended down 90 cts at $25.15-25 a barrel.
